sentences.text: 3. The applicant was arrested on 14/11/2016.
The  1/4  Urmila Ingale 12-ba-4305-2021.doc victim at the relevant time was 4 and 1/2 years of age.
The accusations against the applicant is very serious in nature.
The trial has commenced.
I am informed that 3 witnesses have been examined.
There are 10 more witnesses to be examined.
If the child witness is not examined, learned trial Court is requested to examine the child witness within a period of 1 month from the date of production of this order.
The applicant is in custody for more than 6 years and 2 months.
There are no criminal antecedent reported against the applicant.
In view of this long incarceration, the applicant can be enlarged on bail as the trial Court is likely to take some more time as there are 10 more witnesses to be examined.
Hence, the following order.
ORDER (a) The application is allowed.

(b) The applicant - Manoj Shankar alias Kailash Raut in connection with C.R.No. I-655 of 2016 dated 14/11/2016 registered with Waliv Police Station shall be released on bail on furnishing P.R.
bond in the sum Urmila Ingale 12-ba-4305-2021.doc of Rs.25,000/- with one or more local sureties in the like amount.
(c) The applicant shall not leave the area of Palghar district till the trial is over without persmission of the trial Court.
